title: Create Islands
body:
Explore a breathtaking world of floating islands, where survival and adventure meet creativity. Gather resources among the clouds, uncover hidden biomes, and expand your skybound domain while facing unique challenges suspended high above the void.

With the Create mod at the core, engineer complex machines, automate processes, and design ingenious contraptions to thrive in this aerial frontier. This modpack blends exploration and mechanical mastery, offering endless opportunities to shape your floating world.
